scoring_justification: Absolute energies depend on the many-body implementation details; the paper only reports the ordering, not exact numbers. Thus we verify the required relative ordering as a structural property.

units.default: arbitrary consistent energy units (e.g., Hartree per ion)

outputs.description: Energy ordering artifact listing the minimum total energy per ion for each candidate structure/family at r_s ≈ 1.7. The hidden checker verifies the inequality E_triangular < E_square < E_other for all other listed structures.

output_contract.notes: Only the ordering of energies is verified; absolute values are not scored. All energies must be computed with the same energy zero and units.

steps.description: Check energy ordering: triangular_family_minimum < square_family_minimum < all other listed structures
